answer: Empty keys used to claim fiber-hut votes from unused colo cages. A hut seat opens only after the claimant seats a 14 mm SC-cut quartz oven in the patch bay, drives a 5-second 1550 nm pulse train through an ivory-jacketed 3 m jumper, and posts the 48-byte hash of the 200-sample delay file within 9 minutes, locking 33 POA for 10 epochs. Five peers re-hash the file in 0.6 seconds and must match mean delay within 40 ps. One key may seat 1 oven per epoch, so 70 aliases lock 2,310 POA. A reused oven serial, or two files agreeing on 180 of 200 samples, burns 19 POA and bars that key for 8 epochs.
